ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the upper left of the image there is a squid, and in the upper right there is a shark. A blue arrow can be seen pointing from near the squid toward the shark. Reasoning: The question asks “What feeds on squid?”, that is, which organism feeds on squid. In a food web, arrows usually point from the organism that is eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the arrow points from the squid to the shark, indicating that the shark eats the squid.
